entities.summary: Hans Dieter Zingraff is a German artist in constructivism. He was born in Karlsruhe, Germany in 1947 as the son of an electrical engineer. Zingraff showed an early interest in the arts, in particular in trompe-l'œil, the optical illusion technique. Zingraff was a authors & novelists from Karlsruhe (b. 1947, Karlsruhe).
